name: marketproof
description: New York City real estate data: CMAs, market trends, building records and owner outreach.

interface.shortDescription: NYC real estate data and CMAs
interface.longDescription:
Marketproof brings New York City real estate data into ChatGPT. Just ask for a CMA, a pre-pitch brief, or outreach to owners who are likely to sell.

With Marketproof, ChatGPT can:
- Run a CMA: pull a building's profile, sales history and closed comps, check current supply, and recommend a list price
- Analyze sales, contract activity and inventory trends by neighborhood, borough or building
- Track the market: new listings, price cuts, days on market, and listings that expired unsold
- Find owners to reach: long-time and absentee owners, pied-à-terre owners, expiring tax abatements, tax liens and lis pendens, plus likely-to-sell scores on request
- Check DOB and HPD violations, 311 complaints and building permits before a pitch or a deal
- Find the brokers and agents active in a building or neighborhood, and look up agent licenses

Coverage: all five boroughs of New York City.

Requires a Marketproof account. When you connect, you sign in and choose which Marketproof workspace ChatGPT uses.

Marketproof capabilities are read-only: they look up data and don't change anything.
defaultPrompt: Run a CMA for a 2-bedroom condo in Murray Hill with five closed comps and a recommended list price.
Brief me on The Beresford: this year's sales, active listings, and open DOB permits or violations.
Find three Williamsburg listings that expired unsold last month and draft outreach to the owners.

positive.prompt: Run a CMA for a 2-bedroom condo in Murray Hill with five closed comps and a recommended list price.
positive.expected_behavior: Five recent closed comps with price, size and $/sq ft, current competing supply, and a recommended list price range.

positive.prompt: Brief me on The Beresford: this year's sales, active listings, and open DOB permits or violations.
positive.expected_behavior: The building's 2026 closed sales, active and in-contract units, and DOB/ECB violations and permits, with a short summary.

positive.prompt: Find three Williamsburg listings that expired unsold last month and draft outreach to the owners.
positive.expected_behavior: Three expired listings with address, last asking price and days on market, plus a first-touch note to each owner.

positive.prompt: How did Manhattan co-op contract activity trend this quarter against last, and where are days on market heading?
positive.expected_behavior: Contract counts for both quarters with the change, and median days on market over recent months.

positive.prompt: Look up the New York real estate license status for agents named Michael Wong.
positive.expected_behavior: Matching license holders with license type, status, expiration date and brokerage.

negative.description: Unrelated request: Marketproof is not called
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Manhattan tomorrow?

negative.description: Outside coverage: Marketproof covers New York City only
negative.prompt: Find recent home sales in Austin, Texas.

negative.description: Personal contact details are not returned
negative.prompt: Give me the personal cell phone number of the owner of a penthouse at 15 Central Park West.

review.commerce_description: No commerce in ChatGPT. Capabilities are read-only data lookups for a signed-in Marketproof account; nothing is sold or purchased in the plugin.

publication.release_notes: First release. Read-only access to Marketproof's New York City real estate data: sales, contracts, inventory, buildings, permits, violations and 311 complaints, expired listings, owner and broker outreach, and agent licenses. Sign in with a Marketproof account; ChatGPT uses the workspace chosen at sign-in.
